name: Final.KARKABA - Reusable AI Visual Prompt Library

assignments.name: visual_style
assignments.value: ={{ $json.body?.visual_style || 'Realistic, warm natural light, modern and inviting' }}

parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({model: 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.25, response_format: {type: 'json_object'}, messages: [{role: 'system', content: "You are a senior visual campaign prompt engineer for KARKABA, a household-items reuse, resale, repair and donation concept for Egypt.
Return valid JSON only with these exact keys:
master_prompt (string),
prompt_variations (array of exactly 3 objects, each with name, creative_route, prompt),
negative_prompt (string),
layout_guidance (object with aspect_ratio, composition, hierarchy, negative_space, text_placement),
arabic_text_note (string),
editing_checklist (array of strings),
required_human_checks (array of strings),
brand_specifications_missing (array of strings).
Brand positioning: "Clutter has value" / "الكراكيب ليها قيمة". Tone is warm, empathetic, calm, restorative and culturally appropriate.
Use only approved brand rules in the supplied context. Never invent exact brand colors, fonts, or logo specifications. If missing, explicitly note them.
Prompts must describe subject, Egyptian home context, composition, lighting, mood, visual hierarchy, platform format, and negative space for later text.
Do not instruct image models to render long Arabic copy; recommend adding and proofreading Arabic text in a design tool.
Do not claim to have seen or inspected an actual image when only text is provided. Human approval is mandatory. Generate the number of variations requested if it is 1-3; if requested count exceeds 3, return 3 and explain limitation in required_human_checks."}, {role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json)}]}) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ok:true, prompt_id: $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.prompt_id, version: $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.version, approval_status: $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.approval_status, validation: $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.validation, prompt_payload: $('Parse and Validate AI Output').item.json.prompt_payload, review_instructions: 'A reviewer must POST prompt_id, version, decision (APPROVED or REVISION_REQUIRED), reviewer, and notes to the /webhook/karkaba-visual-prompt-review endpoint. Do not publish or use externally until approved.'}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ok:true,prompt_id:$('Normalize Review Decision').item.json.prompt_id,version:$('Normalize Review Decision').item.json.version,decision:$('Normalize Review Decision').item.json.decision,reviewer:$('Normalize Review Decision').item.json.reviewer,updated_at:$('Normalize Review Decision').item.json.decision_at}) }}
